name: KPIS CTA Buttons
author: Agencia KPIs

sections.description:
KPIS CTA Buttons lets you display floating call-to-action buttons on the front end of your website.

The plugin is simple to configure and helps visitors quickly contact your business through phone, contact page, or WhatsApp.

Features included:

  • Floating phone button
  • Floating WhatsApp button
  • Floating contact page button
  • Country code support
  • Separate position controls for each button
  • Responsive sidebar display
  • Lightweight and easy to configure
  • Translation ready

Available Languages

  • English
  • Spanish
  • Portuguese (Brazil)

Demo

Homepage: https://www.agenciakpis.com/
Inner Page: https://www.agenciakpis.com/servicios/posicionamiento-seo/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kpis-cta-buttons folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the plugin settings page from the admin menu.
  4. Configure the phone, WhatsApp, and contact page button options.
  5. Save your settings and check the front end.
sections.faq:
What buttons can I display?

You can display phone, WhatsApp, and contact page buttons.

Can I choose the position of each button?

Yes. Each button includes its own position setting.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. The plugin is ready for translation.
